engine_loop: Perform the current turn-based action, if any.
Check state-based actions repeatedly until none apply.
Put waiting triggered abilities on the stack in active-player/nonactive-player order.
Give priority to the active player.
After every player passes in succession, resolve the top stack item; if the stack is empty, advance the step or phase.
After each resolution or action, repeat state-based actions and trigger processing.

commander.commander_tax: Two additional generic mana for each previous cast from the command zone.

architecture_rules: Server is authoritative for hidden information, randomness, legality, and state transitions.
Every card is a stable game object with an instance ID separate from its card-definition ID.
All changes are events; replacements can transform events before commit, prevention can reduce or stop them, and triggers observe committed events.
Costs are paid before a spell or ability is placed on the stack.
Target legality is checked when chosen and again on resolution.
Zone changes normally create a new object identity; explicitly persistent digital properties need a stable lineage ID.
Never parse English card text directly inside the UI. Convert card text to structured abilities or attach tested card scripts.
